title: Operation Safed Sagar: The Untold Story of the Kargil War
synopsis: As the Kargil War erupts between India and Pakistan, the Golden Arrows squadron of the Air Force takes flight on a dangerous mission behind enemy lines.

title: Clean Up Company
synopsis: 3 boys stumble upon an opportunity to make easy money by getting rid of dead bodies in a small city marred by gang wars. Things quickly take a turn for the worse and they end up neck deep in trouble fighting to survive.

title: 108 Base Hospital Uri
synopsis: Resilient army doctors at 108 Base Hospital, Uri, navigate personal and professional battles whilst saving lives in a conflict-torn zone.

title: The Legend of Karna
synopsis: A warrior from the Mahabharata who is born to Kunti and the Sun God Surya but raised in a charioteer’s household. He possesses the gift of bow mastery that rivals the greatest warriors of his age, compelling him to enter a grand tournament usually reserved only for kings and princes, altering the course of an empire forever.

title: Yeh Fitoor Tera
synopsis: Reclusive Saumya finds the strength to reclaim her life when she meets Jeet, a free-spirited rebel. A passionate love story blooms in the heart of Prayagraj.

title: Laziness Saves
synopsis: Launched by HDFC Bank, 'Vigil Aunty Says - Laziness Saves', a fraud awareness campaign featuring its Vigil Aunty character alongside seven stand-up comedians.

title: Service Girl
synopsis: A viral video destroys Divya's world overnight. When everyone she loves rejects her, she decides to fight back. Her search for the truth pulls her into a criminal underworld far more dangerous than she imagined, where every step closer puts her life at greater risk.

title: Bhojpuri Bawaal
synopsis: Welcome to the lively world of Bhojpuri entertainment and culture, featuring some of its biggest names, where the heart is as big as the drama.

title: Dilon Ki Ram Leela
synopsis: Yearning for her father's love, Leela finds healing, hope and belonging in Ram.

title: Hustle 5 - Apna Homeground
synopsis: A new season brings India's fiercest rappers, iconic Squad Bosses, and Badshah as judge as they battle for the ultimate rap champion title.

title: Chumbak
synopsis: Five quirky families navigate life as neighbors in Chumbak Colony, where chaotic conflicts and hilarious antics turn each day into a new chapter.

title: The Revolutionaries
synopsis: The Revolutionaries narrates the inspiring tale of brave young Indian freedom fighters who fought for ending British Raj with their unwavering spirit and ideology.
